title: TypeScript 6.0, its tsc on MIRAGE's node, on BusyBox
author: Microsoft (TypeScript); MIRAGE (node's API in JavaScript); BusyBox from Docker Hub
licenseName: Apache 2.0 (TypeScript: LICENSE.txt in the package), MIT (MIRAGE), GPL 2 (BusyBox)
notes: TypeScript 6.0.3 from npm's registry (its tarball, checked by its integrity), the last tsc written in JavaScript (TypeScript 7 is a Go program), installed as npm -g lays it: tsc on the PATH. Its JavaScript runs on MIRAGE's node, the browser's own engine, beside the x86 BusyBox shell. Try: tsc hello.ts && node hello.js; tsc --noEmit --strict hello.ts; tsc --watch hello.ts.
